## What problem does this solve?

Describe the user-facing pain. "I'd like X" is fine; "I want a Y" is even
better when you can show the user need behind it.

## Proposed solution

What you have in mind — UI sketch, API shape, behaviour. Doesn't have to be
fully designed.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why this one wins.

## Scope check

- [ ] Doesn't require multi-database support, multi-tenancy, or a plugin
      marketplace (these are out-of-scope for alpha).
- [ ] I'd be willing to send a PR for this (optional).
